text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM thread. Moss's notes have two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

1. **#PD-4492** is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it the same day, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through cleanly.
2. **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags. It went to tier-2 support, and the note has no date.

I told Dana what I left out and why:
- **Other accounts:** #4409, #4412 and FR-882 are in the Central digest but belong to Central accounts.
- **Not from Moss:** #4092 is an IT ticket from #north-random.
- **No ticket numbers:** two other Moss digests mention Quarrendon but don't give any.
- **Different company:** Quarendon Freightways (one "r") isn't our customer.

I only checked files and channels Dana can see herself. Six of Moss's notes are in the shared files (four North and two Central team digests), and I read all of them.

The knowledge brain refused my search because its access token isn't tied to any member. I told Dana I couldn't check it, so the list may be incomplete if Moss has notes elsewhere. Someone on the brain host can fix this by tying the token to a member: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'`. A shared bot like this one would instead need `--may-act-for` permission.
